objective: Replace GPT session handover and closure narrative with a lean, enforceable Session Closure V2 and Session Bootstrap V2 pattern that preserves autonomy while requiring real evidence for closure.

advisory_sections: MEMORY_WRITE only when durable decision/constraint/path/failure changes

back_off: Do not force verbose memory writes every session
Do not require open loops to be empty in multi-job operations
Do not block workers on cosmetic fields
go_further: Add GitHub validator for inbox schema
Update receipt writer to include closure evidence

assumptions: Connector write to GitHub is available
PEN worker or GitHub Action may consume inbox JSON asynchronously
This chat can create the inbox job but cannot fabricate downstream worker receipts

actions.expected_result: PEN job exists and is readable from GitHub
Future session handovers enforce Closure V2 without blocking useful autonomy

checks: File contains autonomy_balance back_off and go_further controls

closure.close_signal: File fetch verifies the committed PEN inbox job content. Downstream worker receipt remains separate evidence and must not be invented.
closure.fallback: If inbox create fails because file exists, fetch existing file and classify idempotent duplicate as acceptable if content matches.
